name: Nirvana Health
one_liner: AI-powered insurance eligibility verification with 94% accuracy and Cardless Verification™ for behavioral health practices.
short_description: Nirvana is an AI-powered insurance eligibility verification platform built for behavioral health that achieves 94% accuracy with Cardless Verification™ technology.
long_description: Nirvana is an AI-powered insurance eligibility verification platform originally built for behavioral health that now serves the broader healthcare industry. The platform's flagship product, OneVerify, provides real-time coverage checks with 94% accuracy on patient cost estimates and continuously monitors coverage throughout the care journey. Nirvana's Cardless Verification™ technology can identify active insurance using only name, date of birth, and zip code—even with incorrect member IDs or demographic errors. The platform has supported 100,000+ providers with 2M+ patient visits annually, saving practices an average of 5 hours/day on benefit verification (99% faster). Pricing is available as pay-as-you-go per verification or committed volume with no per-check fees. Nirvana integrates via API, direct EHR connections, or a biller-facing app requiring no coding.

faqs.q: How accurate is Nirvana's eligibility verification?
faqs.a: Nirvana claims 94% accuracy on patient cost estimates, significantly higher than traditional verification methods. Their AI-powered system handles data entry errors and incomplete information.
Cardless Verification™ identifies active insurance using only name, date of birth, and zip code—even when patients provide incorrect member IDs or don't have their insurance card.
Nirvana offers two models: pay-as-you-go (per verification) or committed volume (no per-check fees with upfront commitment). Higher volume commitments receive lower per-check pricing.
Yes, Nirvana offers API-based integrations, direct EHR connections, and a user-friendly biller app that requires no coding. They work with major behavioral health EHRs.
